thread:
maria_v: Quick heads-up — ran a cross-GPU stability scan for fused-paged + flash variants across A100 / H100 / L40S. Found a surprising regression on H100 at seq_len=128, batch=8.

Daniels: Got logs? rough numbers?

maria_v: Putting a short summary here. Perf-bot posted the auto-summary and I uploaded full traces to S3: s3://redwood-perf/attn/scans/1919504321/ :link:

perf-bot: SUMMARY: H100: fused_paged_v2 drops ~22% p99 throughput at seq=128,b=8 vs baseline (flash_gemm_attn). A100 & L40S show stable scaling. Observed increased KV-cache spill events on H100 causing kernel fallback to flash_gemm_attn.

leo_eng: Is fallback to flash_gemm_attn? can you paste the kernel selection log snippet?

maria_v: Sure — snippet below (nvlog):

```
kernel_selector: chosen=fused_paged_v2
fallback_trigger: kv_cache_spill
fallback_to: flash_gemm_attn
mem_used_before: 42.1GB
mem_peak: 49.6GB
seq_len: 128
batch: 8
gpu: H100-80GB
```

ash: Did you try forcing a different kernel or reducing batch? any latency/cost tradeoffs?

maria_v: Reduced batch -> batch=4 eliminates the spill and restores throughput to expected levels. Forcing fused_paged_v2 with artificially low kv-cache cap still causes OOM in some traces. Looks correlated with live seq distribution tails (some requests jump to 130-200 tokens occasionally).

kira: Could be L2 / caching behavior on H100 — we saw similar with tiled kernels in the past. Can you collect NVTX + CUPTI counters (L2 hit/miss, dram reads)?

maria_v: Scheduling NVTX + CUPTI traces now, ETA ~30m. Also noticed temp buffer allocations spiking during the fused tiled stage; perf-bot flagged a recent commit that tweaks tiling params.

daniels: For rollout safety: add a runtime heuristic — if seq_len > 96 && batch >= 8 on H100, prefer flash_gemm_attn. Also emit kv_cache_alloc metrics so we can alert on spikes.

leo_eng: Agreed. More robust: compute expected_mem = base + per_kv * seq_len * batch; if expected_mem > 0.8 * gpu_mem pick low-mem kernel. That will catch tails without hardcoding seq threshold.

maria_v: I'll push a quick kernel-router change with that cost model and run a canary (10% traffic) on dedicated cluster. Also running evals to check FP16 vs FP32 temp buffer optimizations.

perf-bot: NOTE: regression window points to commit 0a1b2c (fused_paged_v2 tiling tweak) — introduced larger temporary scratch buffer for the tiled stage.

ash: If it's only temp buffer size, can we switch tiled plan to use FP16 scratch or smaller tile dims? Might affect accuracy.

maria_v: Quick accuracy checks look OK for decoder-only models on FP16 scratch (softmax drift negligible). Running a broader eval suite now. Will update NVTX traces when ready.

kira: :thumbsup: Keep the thread updated. If NVTX/CUPTI show L2 thrashing, try reverting tiling params or fall back to the old tiling for H100 until we have a better memory plan.

maria_v: Will do. Posting raw nvprof link when available. Thanks all.
